hotels.title: Northern Lights Hideaway: Lofoten Islands Luxury Cabins with Daily Breakfast & Airport Transfers
hotels.description: A proud member of the Small Luxury Hotels of the World collection, Nusfjord Village & Resort is found where mountains, sea and a historic fishing harbour meet. Here, you trade ordinary hotel corridors for restored fishermen’s cabins and timber buildings in one of Norway’s oldest fishing villages, with original character softened by luxury comforts. Days can begin with breakfast before you head onto the water for kayaking, fishing or a RIB adventure, or climb into Lofoten’s mountain scenery on a guided hike. Between adventures, return to the outdoor sanctuary at Nusfjord Arctic Wellness, where a traditional wood-fired hot tub, sauna and outdoor shower look out to the sea. After dark, you may catch the northern lights if lucky, while summer brings the glow of the midnight sun. When hunger calls, settle into Restaurant Karoline for Nordic cooking shaped by the sea, or stop by Landhandleriet Café for a lighter bite. As evening settles in, follow the harbour to Aurora Matbar on the dock, or savour pizza and wine by candlelight at Oriana Tavern. Your stay also includes a Norwegian delicacy experience, giving you an extra taste of Lofoten’s local flavours.
